steps: Stream an <action> proposal component and click it before the closing tag arrives.
Finish the component, then click again.
Switch run while the component is open.
assertions: Early click does nothing; after validation the action goes through app-side confirmation and server checks.
Stale run cannot update or re-enable the component.
Export/save uses original received text, not display-time completion or placeholder markup.
Snapshot replacement resets parser state without duplicating components.
